notes: Starting cards as posted at the top of the list: Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough, Tatooine, Tatooine: Cantina (posted 'Pub'), Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Insurrection, Squadron Assignments, Staging Areas, Heading For The Medical Frigate (posted 'HFTMF'); these count toward the 60.

Tournament: the description says the deck 'went 6-0 during the Calamari Continental Championships' and the strategy says it went undefeated on day one and day two; a review response says 'Adam won' the event (Adam Amy, per DeckTech 18166). Played in Melbourne-area (Calamari region, Australia) play; on day one a POAS was in place of Cantina Brawl.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: the post says twice it is a pre-Coruscant deck, and the list has no Coruscant-set cards; Tatooine dested the Light Premiere printing.
Posted 'Watch Your Step/I Can Do WHAT ?' dested the objective Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough ('I Can Do WHAT ?' is not the flip side's title).
Posted 'Pub' dested Tatooine: Cantina (Light): the strategy uses 'Pub' for the Cantina site ('Cantina Brawl if they go for a beer'; 'victorians play WYS ... we like starting with the pub in play').
Posted 'A Stu Maneuvers (best card in the deck)' dested A Few Maneuvers: the description says 'It all started when Stuart Jones signed my A Few Maneuvers'.

Posted 'Squadron Assingnments' dested Squadron Assignments; 'Home One Docking Bay' Home One: Docking Bay; 'Out Of Comission/Transmission Terminated' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Control/Tunnel Vision' Control & Tunnel Vision; 'Houjix/Out Of Nowhere' Houjix & Out Of Nowhere.
player_note: On day one the deck ran a POAS in place of Cantina Brawl; the posted list is the day-two list.
